name: Khostty
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: The bounded latest default history is README/badge changes. No new terminal implementation is demonstrated by that sample.
role: Native terminal fork or embedding dependency
concerns: Retain current work instead of assuming the lack of a push means no activity.

next_actions.title: Identify owned delta and distribution
next_actions.work: Return exact worktree/source base, local patches, intended role (standalone/embedded) and installed build.
next_actions.acceptance: Clear upstream/owned feature and compatibility map.

next_actions.title: Run the terminal correctness corpus
next_actions.work: Exercise Unicode, input/IME, resize, alternate-screen, paste, shell integration and high-volume output using real native UI.
next_actions.acceptance: No regressions against upstream on mandatory terminal semantics; native captures and diagnostics.

next_actions.title: Prove the actual differentiated use
next_actions.work: Qualify the embedding/integration or workflow the fork exists for, including lifecycle and updates.
next_actions.acceptance: A useful owned outcome with reproducible performance and safe update behavior.

ecosystem_contract: Keep terminal protocol semantics authoritative; use narrow integration adapters rather than duplicating native renderer/editor stacks.
parent_acceptance: The intended terminal or embedded terminal is usable and maintains the required semantics of its upstream.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
